entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an official Hermes Agent provider through a managed cloud, an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, or an OSS SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This AGPL-3.0 context database offers observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated significant task-completion gains during LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated memory system utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed entity relationships to manage agent intelligence. It features gap analysis to identify missing information in queries and supports multi-tenant deployments with scoped data access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a high-scale memory engine featuring automated fact extraction, byte-level deduplication, and a custom vector graph engine. It supports hybrid RAG search and provides official connectors for platforms including Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create an agent memory system that learns over time. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or specialized Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables stateful agents through reasoning-first memory extraction from conversation histories. It serves as the upstream library for self-hosted Hermes wrappers and supports managed, local, or Docker Compose deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like commits and branches for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes a React-powered TUI for interactive management.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates with Hermes via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system combines persistent Qdrant vector search with structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Redis and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like traces and playbooks to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate the effectiveness of context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed DAG with depth-aware summary nodes. It includes specialized agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material to ensure no information is lost during long sessions.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library, enabling private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agents. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Discord, GitHub, and Obsidian.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses an open engram YAML format to store human-readable data on local disks for multi-agent systems. It facilitates retrieval through a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings via MCP integration.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, and integrates directly with Hermes through MCP and dedicated plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3x while saving up to 36% in tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. The project features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Telegram.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local cache. It utilizes SQLite-vec and node-llama-cpp for storage and operates as an MCP-native server for major coding clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It functions as a local-first system or MCP-native server using a SQLite-backed vault for governed retrieval.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool focuses on reducing prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking for tool-schema selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent context. It prioritizes information using a 1-10 importance ranking system and BM25 keyword search to ensure high-priority memories surface during prefetch.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores project state and decision logs in plain Markdown files for cross-session continuity. It uses hash-checked proposals for setup and handoffs, providing a versioned workflow adapter for Hermes and other coding agents.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Focusing on episodic memory, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate, real event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains. It allows agents to pay for services or charge for their own API usage with direct wallet settlement and zero transaction fees.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider ensures durable cross-session memory through semantic search and a local SQLite reliability layer with a write outbox. It manages agent state by performing pre-turn context injections and capturing snapshots at the end of each session.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin serves as a local capability index for scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It includes five native tools for searching and fetching information, with support for automatic generation of tool routing notes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking for both manual and automated memory storage.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers high security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It supports multiple retrieval methods, including HNSW ANN and sparse recall, and can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Designed for private repository management, this plugin adds deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing local code. It relies on a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage to facilitate grounded Q&A and file reads.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 distinct tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, while automatically checkpointing context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This database-free curation tool uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned Markdown memories. It provides specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale data or contradictions, proposing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven methodology to execute engineering tasks autonomously through a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It functions as a plugin for various coding agents and CLI tools to enforce rigorous software development standards.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that provides CLI support for 26 executables, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It allows agents to iterate on live designs via sandboxed iframe previews and export finished artifacts to formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured security skills mapped to industry frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and the NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a standardized foundation for cybersecurity operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that grants agents persistent long-term memory across different sessions. By combining vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning, it enables complex search capabilities through Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 different diagram presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text directly into diagram formats.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router for delegated permissions, escrow, and x402 payments. It integrates a verification and dispute resolution layer to facilitate secure transactions between autonomous entities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports rewrite and edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for casual, professional, or technical tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables the collective evolution of agent capabilities by supporting skill merging and cross-pollination across platforms like Hermes and QwenPaw. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and managing the growth of the skill library.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state within a project's local directory to ensure continuity across agent interactions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills designed for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes ready-to-paste exports and specific integrations for tools like Slack, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin grants agents the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Windsurf, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose new, reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions and domain-specific thinking lenses for complex tasks. It enhances transparency by reporting findings alongside an assessment of potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that support instructions, resources, and scripts through a remote registry. It utilizes progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency while offering type-safe support for programmatic skills.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite and Full modes to accommodate varying project complexities.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into unified documents. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source code edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Operating via a mechanism kernel without background services, this harness manages long-running agents through Supervisor, Lead, and Peer roles. It facilitates structured memory and cross-feature learning, requiring Herdr for hosting Supervisor rooms and lane panes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin establishes cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a specialized pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.

It provides specialized capabilities for CRE and ACE services to ensure blockchain interoperability.

entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation models with specialized modules for cinematic and archival formats. The project includes API integration and prompt optimization guidelines for audio directing and product advertising.

entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a CLI and Python client for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features by supporting TON payments for skill access.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for recovery during long-running processes.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a local-first workflow language that audits AI operations for costs, permissions, and types before execution. It generates tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run, ensuring high-integrity execution via a single Rust binary.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for secure HTTPS communication using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill provides a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. It reduces token usage by filtering skills before LLM calls and supports graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and integrates federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows an agent to handle system design via the Model Context Protocol while the user executes tasks through a tapping interface.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only code review skill that employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial and integration analysis. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings from a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by up to 80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five specific dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill that uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.

entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation based on CVE data. it integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to support comprehensive security operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides production-tested session management to maintain memory between agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for code reviews. It also includes specialized tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.

entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to prevent rot. It uses CI-friendly exit codes to validate skills against runtime-specific profiles and detect structural drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables users to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills from their terminal. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and propose structured updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides 11 monitoring tabs for real-time tracking of token costs, errors, and session health. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards.

It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for verification.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills manage deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool automatically identifies and verifies project-compatible Python runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports integration with environments such as Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. The setup supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and compatibility with both local Ollama models and cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a simple Docker sandbox image that bundles official Hermes installations with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It includes a REST API and CLI for managing per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, reboot-safe deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers using systemd. It configures the Hermes Gateway for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Designed for self-hosted orchestration, this tool governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It offers multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface to manage persistent coding agent sessions via tmux. It supports multi-repo workspace management and sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and can detect HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales from single agents to automated teams via a task bus pattern. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.

entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform allows users to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It features a Kanban board for task tracking, live streaming of agent reasoning, and human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Built on Hermes Agent profiles, this web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.

entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling through parallel model querying and synthesis.

It automatically synchronizes the index on every file change and supports multiple languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.

entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent interactions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help Hermes Agent and other AI providers build better user interfaces. It integrates directly with markdown-supporting agents to provide structured UI development assistance.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It features multi-device synchronization to keep usage data consistent across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It provides control over visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.

entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to reverse recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities and automatic context recall for frameworks and chat bots on platforms like Telegram and Slack. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code to enhance agent persistence.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts to flag overlapping tool descriptions or inconsistent schemas. It integrates into development workflows via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks, utilizing HERM v1.1 scoring for validation.

It supports unified configuration across 10 platforms, including Discord and WhatsApp, while providing usage analytics and multi-profile model discovery.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent orchestration. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated memory browser and skills manager.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native mobile clients for iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports MCP tools, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime directly to the active browser context. It features live browser control with explicit approval gates and site-aware drafting capabilities for various writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone application that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from iOS 18+ devices. It pairs with a hermes-webui server via HTTPS or Tailscale to enable real-time chat, task management, and file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It provides a specialized tmux operator view for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live quota burn by model, tokens, or cost across 15 agent sources. It operates locally without telemetry, providing searchable transcripts and image browsing for coding-agent CLIs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights and supports both cloud and local AI models via LM Studio. It includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers alongside built-in ComfyUI and TTS support.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers paired with a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Focused on process monitoring, this dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first design with tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a native interface for streaming chat responses.
